Class TriggerEvaluator

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.TriggerEvaluator
public final class TriggerEvaluator extends Object
Decides, from the live price, whether an order's stop has been reached and whether it can fill now. Pure functions with no state, shared by order placement and OrderTriggerEngine.

Prices are the side's executable price: a buy fills at the ask, a sell at the bid.

  • LIMIT: a buy fills when the ask is at or below the limit, a sell when the bid is at or above it - always at the quote, which is then the limit or better.
  • STOP: a buy triggers when the ask rises to the stop, a sell when the bid falls to it, and then fills at the quote like a market order.
  • STOP_LIMIT: triggers like a stop, then works as a limit order; it stays triggered even if the price moves back.

      public static TriggerEvaluator.Evaluation evaluate(Order.OrderType type, Order.Side side, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, boolean alreadyTriggered, BigDecimal price)
      Evaluates an order's conditions against the price it would fill at.
      Parameters:
      type - the order type
      side - the order's side
      limitPrice - the limit price, for LIMIT and STOP_LIMIT
      stopPrice - the stop price, for STOP and STOP_LIMIT

      Returns:
      whether its stop was reached and whether it fills
